title: BioAge Labs Announces Discontinuation of STRIDES Phase 2 Clinical Trial Evaluating Azelaprag in Combination with Tirzepatide for the Treatment of Obesity
description: BioAge Labs has discontinued its STRIDES Phase 2 clinical trial of azelaprag in combination with tirzepatide for obesity treatment due to observations of liver transaminitis in some subjects. The company will evaluate the data and share updated plans for azelaprag in Q1 2025, while continuing to advance its NLRP3 inhibitor program.
